directions.name: Linear

accent.name: Linear indigo
accent.use: the single primary button, the focus ring and the selected issue's left marker; priority and status stay as small coloured glyphs

type.stands_in_for: Linear's custom Inter-derived display and text faces

directions.move: Near-black canvas lifted in tiny tone steps (#08090a page, #0f1011 panels, #18191a hover) with 1px #23252a hairlines and no shadows; 32px issue rows of 13px text with a 12px grey id, a status glyph and a priority glyph before the title.
directions.keep_out: The 80px display headlines and the floating product-screenshot panels belong to the marketing pages; app titles stay near 20px.

directions.name: Vercel

accent.name: Geist black
accent.use: the one solid primary button; links and status use their own small colours

directions.move: White cards on a #fafafa page edged by a 1px #00000014 ring and no shadow, never a grey border alone; 40px controls, the active sidebar row a #ebebeb fill with black text, and Geist Mono for ids, hashes and sentence-case table headers, with titles tracked slightly tight.
directions.keep_out: The develop-preview-ship mesh gradients and the 100px pill call-to-action buttons are marketing furniture, not dashboard parts.

directions.name: Stripe

accent.name: Stripe blurple
accent.use: the primary button, links and the selected sidebar item; pressed state darkens to #2e2b8c

directions.move: Deep navy ink (#0d253d) instead of black, light 300 headings and figures beside 500 labels, and tabular figures in every money cell; white cards on #f6f9fc lifted by a blue-tinted shadow (0 1px 3px rgba(0,55,112,0.08)).
directions.keep_out: The flowing gradient-mesh hero and the cream feature bands belong to stripe.com, not to a table of payments.

directions.name: Mercury

accent.name: Mercury indigo
accent.use: the one filled action pill per screen and the selected nav item

directions.move: Unhurried and soft: 15px text at 400 with headings at only 480, violet-tinted ink (#28253b), roomy 48px rows, and depth from tone rather than lines or shadow; one filled indigo pill (40px tall, fully round) while other actions are pills tinted rgba(82,102,235,0.1).
directions.keep_out: The night-sky homepage with glowing 3D objects stays on the marketing site.

directions.name: Notion

accent.name: Notion blue
accent.use: the primary button, links and the text cursor; tags and callouts take soft pastel tints instead

directions.move: Warm paper rather than cool grey: warm brown-black ink (#37352f) on white, a #f6f5f4 sidebar, and hover shown as a faint warm wash instead of borders; a large 32px page title over plain content, with properties as quiet label-value rows and tags as pastel chips.
directions.keep_out: The navy hero with hand-drawn figures and sticky-note dots stays out of the workspace.

directions.name: Raycast

accent.name: Raycast white
accent.use: the single primary action and the selected row's text; everything else stays grey

directions.move: The whole screen as one floating command window: a search field on top, 36px list rows with a rounded #121212 highlight on the selected row, and keyboard hints drawn as small 4px keycaps on the right; Inter with ss03 and slightly open tracking.
directions.keep_out: The red diagonal hero stripe and the coloured illustration accents never reach list rows or controls.

directions.name: Resend

accent.name: Resend white
accent.use: the one primary button; delivery status uses a small bright green dot (#11ff99) and links a quiet blue

type.stands_in_for: Domaine Display (licensed) for titles; ABC Favorit (licensed) for UI

directions.move: Pure black with almost nothing on it: panels one step up (#0a0a0c) edged by faint white-alpha hairlines, generous 48px rows, and a serif page title as the only flourish over a quiet Inter body; code and ids in a mono face.
directions.keep_out: The atmospheric light glows and the white email-mockup insets are showcase art, not dashboard surfaces.

directions.name: Supabase

accent.name: Supabase green
accent.use: the primary button (with near-black text, never white), the active sidebar item and success states

type.stands_in_for: Circular (licensed); column names and values in Source Code Pro (@fontsource-variable/source-code-pro)

directions.move: A developer console in charcoal (#1c1c1c) with flat hairline-edged panels, one mint-green button carrying dark #171717 text, small square-ish corners and never pills, and dense 32px table rows with a monospace face for column names and values.
directions.keep_out: The white marketing track with its 64px tightly tracked headlines and stacked screenshot collages stays on supabase.com.

directions.name: PostHog

accent.name: PostHog amber
accent.use: the one primary button per screen and the active product tab marker

directions.move: An olive-tinted cream ground (#eeefe9) holding white panels boxed by 1 px olive-grey lines and no shadow at all; rank comes from weight (400 text, 700 headings), and a single amber fill (#f7a501, dark ink label) marks the action that matters.
directions.keep_out: Hedgehog mascots, cartoon art and tall promotional sections have no place beside a working table.

directions.name: Sentry

accent.name: Sentry violet
accent.use: the primary button, the selected issue row marker and focus rings

directions.move: Deep plum ink (#1f1633) on white with violet #6a5fc1 for the main button and the selected issue, button labels in sentence case at weight 600, and stack frames and event ids in a monospace face.
directions.keep_out: Starfield backdrops, sticker art, the lime squiggle and lime highlight chips stay off the product screen.

directions.name: Cal.com

accent.name: Cal ink
accent.use: the primary button and the active pill of a segmented switch

directions.move: Page titles in Cal Sans with tight tracking over 14 px Inter, near-black #111111 primary buttons, and view switches drawn as a grey pill track holding one white pill lifted by a 0 1px 2px shadow.
directions.keep_out: The black footer band and the wide hero spacing of the public site do not carry into the booking app.

directions.name: Figma

accent.name: Figma black
accent.use: the primary action and the active tab, both as solid pills

directions.move: Strict black and white: the main action and the active tab are solid black buttons, text stays light at 330 with 540 for labels, and order comes from weight and size rather than shades of grey.
directions.keep_out: The saturated pastel colour blocks and the magenta promo fill belong to showcase pages, not to a file list.

directions.name: Intercom

accent.name: Intercom ink
accent.use: the send and save buttons and the selected conversation's bar

directions.move: A warm cream ground (#f5f1ec) with white panels and no shadow, so lift comes from tone alone; buttons are near-black rectangles, never pills, and every label reads in sentence case at 500.
directions.keep_out: Fin orange (#ff5600) marks the AI agent's own surfaces and never paints an ordinary button or link.

directions.name: Superhuman

accent.name: Superhuman midnight
accent.use: the one filled action and the focused message row

directions.move: A keyboard-first reading surface with no side nav: 15 px Inter at 460 with 540 for sender names, 48 px rows on a warm off-white, midnight indigo #1b1938 for the single filled action, and a soft 0 1px 3px shadow under raised panels.
directions.keep_out: The portrait hero, the violet sky backdrop and the teal closing band are brand theatre, not inbox furniture.

directions.name: Airtable

accent.name: Airtable blue
accent.use: links, the ring around the selected cell and the primary action

directions.move: A dense grid of 32 px rows split by 1 px #dddddd cell lines under a top bar of table tabs, calm 400/500 weights, and blue #1b61c9 kept for links, the selected cell ring and the main action.
directions.keep_out: Rainbow stripe bands and full-bleed coloured story cards stay out of the grid.

directions.name: Clay

accent.name: Clay teal
accent.use: the selected view tab and the featured record's band, while the main button stays near-black

directions.move: A cream canvas (#fffaf0) with deeper cream cards (#f5f0e0) with no shadow, near-black #0a0a0a primary buttons, page titles at 500 with negative tracking, and deep teal #1a3a3a saved for the selected view and featured records.
directions.keep_out: Claymation 3D figures and the saturated pink and lavender feature cards stay on the explainer pages.

directions.name: Cursor

accent.name: Cursor orange
accent.use: the one filled primary button and the unread or running marker; everything else stays in warm greys

type.stands_in_for: CursorGothic (licensed); code and ids in JetBrains Mono (@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono)

directions.move: A warm off-white ground (#f7f7f4) with white panels on 1px warm hairlines and titles at weight 400 with slightly negative tracking; agent or job status shows as small pastel pills (peach for thinking, sage for searching, blue for reading, lilac for editing) while orange marks only the primary action.
directions.keep_out: The large editor screenshots framed inside hero panels and the testimonial bands belong to the marketing site.

directions.name: Warp

accent.name: Warp bone
accent.use: the single filled button and the selected rail icon; there is no chromatic accent, so status alone carries colour

type.stands_in_for: nothing licensed: Warp's own faces are Inter and DM Mono (@fontsource/dm-mono) for commands

directions.move: Every surface is a warm brown-black (#2b2622 ground, #383330 panels) split by 1px warm hairlines, with near-square corners; the only filled button is bone #f7f5f0 with dark text, and commands, ids and timestamps are set in DM Mono at 12px.
directions.keep_out: The Instrument Serif italic headlines and the full-bleed terminal hero artwork are for marketing pages.

directions.name: Wise

accent.name: Wise lime
accent.use: the primary action pill with ink text and the active top-bar tab; never as a success colour

type.stands_in_for: Wise Sans (licensed), the heavy display face

directions.move: A sage ground (#e8ebe6) holding large white cards with no borders or shadows, page titles and balances in Manrope at weight 800 with tight tracking, inputs with a 1px ink border, and 48px lime pills with ink text for the primary action.
directions.keep_out: The weight-900 poster headlines, flag illustrations and the currency-converter hero are marketing.

directions.name: Revolut

accent.name: Revolut cobalt
accent.use: the one primary pill, the active segment of a tab switcher and links

type.stands_in_for: Aeonik Pro (licensed) for titles and amounts

directions.move: A pale grey ground (#f4f4f4) framing one large white sheet with rounded corners and no lines or shadows; titles and amounts in a geometric grotesk at weight 500, body Inter with slightly open tracking (+0.2px), 48px fully rounded buttons, and cobalt #494fdf only on the primary one.
directions.keep_out: The lifestyle photography, floating phone and card mockups, and the black hero bands are marketing.

directions.name: Claude

accent.name: Claude coral
accent.use: the single primary action and the brand mark; selection and hover use the tan surface #efe9de instead

type.stands_in_for: Copernicus or Tiempos for titles and StyreneB for body (licensed)

directions.move: Paper-warm cream (#faf9f5) with surfaces stepped by tone, cream to sand #f5f0e8 to tan #efe9de for the selected row, with no borders on cards and at most a faint 0 1px 3px shadow on hover; page titles in a serif at weight 400, everything else in a plain sans.
directions.keep_out: The hand-drawn spot illustrations and the dark product-demo bands belong to the marketing pages.

directions.name: Mintlify

accent.name: Mintlify mint
accent.use: the active sidebar marker and small filled tags with ink text; never as text or a focus ring on white, and the primary button stays a black pill

type.stands_in_for: nothing licensed: Inter, with Geist Mono (@fontsource-variable/geist-mono) for code

directions.move: Pure white with 1px #e5e5e5 hairlines, a 240px sidebar of 32px items under muted 12px/600 group labels in sentence case, the primary action a black pill, and mint #00d4a4 only as a marker or a tag with ink text.
directions.keep_out: The blurred gradient hero glow and the floating shadowed product mockups are marketing.

directions.name: ClickHouse

accent.name: ClickHouse yellow
accent.use: the one filled button with black text, key metric numbers and links on dark

type.stands_in_for: nothing licensed: Inter, with JetBrains Mono (@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono) for SQL

directions.move: Near-black ground (#0a0a0a) with #1a1a1a panels on 1px #2a2a2a lines, key figures in Inter 700 with tight tracking, coloured electric yellow #faff69, which is also the only filled button (black text); queries and ids in JetBrains Mono.
directions.keep_out: The benchmark leaderboard charts and the giant yellow headline blocks are marketing.

directions.name: Framer

accent.name: Framer blue
accent.use: the focus ring, the selection outline and links only; the primary button is a white pill with black text

directions.move: An inky ground (#090909) where hover and selection lift a surface one step (#141414, then #1c1c1c) instead of drawing borders, Inter with its alternate glyphs on (cv01, cv05, cv09, cv11, ss03), a white pill with black text as the primary action, and #0099ff only as a soft focus halo.
directions.keep_out: The vivid gradient spotlight cards, glowing product renders and showreel motion are marketing.

directions.name: Achromatic ledger

accent.name: Ink
accent.use: the one primary button; the screen's main data series alone takes the chart blue #1d5fbf

directions.move: Build the chrome in ink and grey only: a near-black #141414 primary, a #e5e5e5 grey pill beside it, and blue #1d5fbf on the main data series alone. Set money at 700 and all other figures at 400-500; a changed figure gets a small green or red mark and nothing more.
directions.keep_out: A primary button in a brand colour, KPI tiles with a tint and bold outside money figures do not belong on this screen.

directions.name: Framed sheet

accent.name: Deep teal
accent.use: the 2px underline of the active tab, the main chart series and the one selected state

directions.move: Paint the side nav and the 48px header as one tinted L with no rule at the join. Lay the page on a white sheet with rounded corners, a 1px #e8eaec edge and no shadow, leaving an 8px tinted gap at its right and bottom.
directions.keep_out: A shadow under the sheet, a line where the side nav meets the header, and a fourth level of nesting do not belong on this screen.

directions.name: Accent ladder

accent.name: Raspberry
accent.use: full strength only on the one filled button, the data series and the active nav icon; its pale tints fill the active nav row, badges and progress tracks

directions.move: Use raspberry as a ladder: pale steps (#fdf2f7 fills, #f8dbe8 progress tracks) cover the active nav row, the plan card and the badges, with #6b1d3e as their text. Keep the full #b8336a for marks under a few pixels wide plus the single filled button and the chart line.
directions.keep_out: Raspberry at full strength on a large area, a gradient upgrade chip and a second accent family do not belong on this screen.

directions.name: Editorial greeting

accent.name: Deep teal
accent.use: the one primary action and the second chart series; the first series stays in ink

directions.move: Open the home with a serif page title that greets the team and states today's one fact, over a 12-column grid held in an 1100px column at the centre. Below it, keep every number at weight 400 on #f9f9f9 tonal panels, each holding its title and content directly with nothing boxed inside it.
directions.keep_out: An emoji, a "Welcome back" line, a tracked uppercase date over the greeting and a grey tray around each card do not belong on this screen.

directions.name: Pastel consumer

accent.name: Cobalt
accent.use: the primary action and the main data marks; its pale #dcf1ff tile with #0a3a80 ink codes one category

directions.move: Code each category with a pale tile whose text is the deep shade of that tile's hue, for example #0a3a80 on #dcf1ff. Show every total inside the card it belongs to, at 30-36px and weight 600 with tabular figures; show income in green with a plus and spending in ink.
directions.keep_out: A gradient balance card, a KPI strip across the top and red on each payment out do not belong on this screen.

directions.name: True-black flat

accent.name: Lime
accent.use: data marks only, the main series and a positive change; never buttons, tabs or nav

directions.move: Run one #000000 surface under the nav, the header and the content, and lift cards by lightness only, #111111 on the ground and #2a2a2a for menus and dialogs, never a border or a shadow. Make the primary action a 36px white pill with black text, and mark the current nav item by its label alone, #bbbbbb to #ffffff.
directions.keep_out: A navy or slate night theme, glows and neon borders, and lime on buttons, tabs or nav do not belong on this screen.

directions.name: Data terminal

accent.name: Signal blue
accent.use: the 1px line under the selected tab, toggle, range or nav item, and nothing else

directions.move: Mark whatever is selected with a single 1px #4a8ad6 underline beneath its label, never a fill. Sink cards below the page (#131217 on #171719), and keep figures tabular in white or grey with a written sign such as +$24,000,000.
directions.keep_out: Filled pill tabs, a coloured segmented control, glowing lighter cards and polarity colour on every number do not belong on this screen.
